text: Grok @Bot can help with your taxes

quoted_tweet.author: Jason Freedman
quoted_tweet.text:
I just gave my a Grokbot four years of past tax returns and financial files.  Just a dump of folders and unlabled files.

K-1s, 1099s, mortgage statements, HSA records, and every email with our CPA.  266 files.

I just said, please double check my CPA's work.

A few minutes later, it had found a lot of mistakes.

Mortgage interest left off our 2022 return entirely.

HSA payroll contributions counted twice, four years in a row, which created a penalty tax that never should have existed.

A missing IRA form for Jen that would have cost us.

On this year's return: home office errors, two K-1s missing, an outdated 1099, and startup losses we never claimed.

And a retirement contribution the return already deducted...that we hadn't actually deposited.  

I sent it all to our CPA.  They sent back an amended return.  The bot reviewed that too.

One fix went the wrong direction.  The explanation had typos.

Three versions later, all in one afternoon, it said ready to sign.

Just a few hours start to finish.  With about 90 seconds of my time and attention required. I was just the meat proxy hitting send as Grokbot watched the replies in my email.  

Our CPA is great and turned every fix around the same day.  

We chatted afterwards.  He wanted to know what I was using - just normal ole' grokbot.

I asked him what he was using?  No AI tools.  

I set him up with @magnetictax for next season (we're an investor).  All CPAs should be using Magnetic Tax or something like it.  Every single one.

All individuals should be double checking the work and past work with Grokbot or something like that.  

Want to copy the exact the prompt I used?  it was just this:

"Please do a thorough review of my taxes and help me understand if my CPA made any mistakes"

"Think deeply"

Or just tag your bot into this thread.

Federal prosecutors have charged OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, a Saudi national, with using or attempting to use a device to intercept oral communications, the Justice Department said Tuesday. He is accused of hiding a recorder in an executive conference room at OpenAI’s San Francisco offices. He was arrested Oct. 9 and appeared in federal court Tuesday. The charge is an allegation in a criminal complaint, and he has not been convicted.

According to the complaint, OpenAI staff found the device on or about Sept. 30, plugged into a USB port on the back of a TV and concealed in toilet paper. OpenAI determined it was installed around Sept. 28 and that its contents were encrypted. The complaint alleges CCTV footage showed Alfozan near the room on multiple dates, though he had no authority to access or attend meetings there, and that before Sept. 28 he used a productivity tool to ask about building addresses, meeting rooms, calendars and executive locations.

It further alleges that on Oct. 5 he was seen looking behind the TV, and that OpenAI security later found a second, similar recording device in a bag he left unattended in another room, along with his wallet and ID.

If convicted, he faces up to five years in prison and a $250,000 fine. The release does not allege he acted for a foreign government, does not give a motive, and does not say what, if anything, the device recorded. FBI Director Kash Patel called protecting American AI innovation “one of our highest counterintelligence priorities.”

OpenAI said it used its internal AI models to identify him and trace the device, and that it has no indication he accessed or took model weights, source code or customer data. The company fired him. The FBI is investigating.

text: @HiTw93 @dotey 上电视了

Anthropic 放弃代码管理工具 Git

自己开发了一套名为 Scion 的版本控制系统，来适应 AI 开发需要...

原因是：AI 已经代替人写代码、代码提交呈指数级暴增，传统的 Git 彻底被撑爆...

合并量暴涨12倍：2026年 5 月，Anthropic每天大概合并 2,500 次代码；到了9月，这个数字冲到了每天30,000 多...

仓库庞大且流量惊人：主分支历史记录接近 100 GB，压缩后的本地副本超过 25 GB；为了跑 CI（持续集成），每天需要执行约 2,500 万次 checkout。如果每次都把压缩副本完整拉取，每天要产生 600 PB 以上的网络流量

Git 的设计假设不再匹配负载：Git 的本质是“去中心化、支持离线工作”，默认的完整克隆保留全量历史。但 Anthropic 绝大多数代码客户端都是始终在线的 AI Agent 和云端 CI 任务。

为了让 Git 扛住，他们以前开了几百个镜像节点，但随着合并频率越来越高，主分支更新太快，镜像扩容、更新快照（seeds），以及在部分副本上计算 diff 和 blame 都越来越难维护...

于是他们用 5 个月自研了一套全新的版本控制系统——Scion。

这套新系统的核心逻辑主要有三点：

按需索取：工作的大多是始终联网的 AI 智能体，不需要每次都把全部历史记录下载下来。系统只在需要某些文件时，才去服务器调取对应内容。

服务器挑大梁：版本管理中复杂、繁重的计算主要放在云端服务器完成，客户端主要负责把文件放到磁盘、监测改动和维护简单缓存，极大地节省了本地机器的资源消耗。

更轻便的记录方式：每次保存修改时，系统只记录改动的文件清单和内容指针，创建变更集时不需要给整个代码库加锁；分支引用另行更新，减少大量任务同时提交时的协调和堵塞。

Anthropic 汲取了 Google 的 Piper 和 Meta 的 Sapling 的经验，提出了几个颠覆 Git 的设计原则：

彻底拥抱“客户端永远在线”：客户端不再需要存全量历史，改向服务端要数据。

非对称架构（轻客户端，重服务端）：

Git 里每个客户端都是全功能服务器；

Scion 则把所有算力集中在服务端：由服务端负责算历史、查责任人（blame）、提交、合代码、rebase；客户端只维持一个很小的本地缓存和工作区目录。

全能力 API 化：CI 任务想要比对两个 commit 之间差了什么，不再需要把整个仓库 clone 下来，直接发个 API 调服务端算好的结果即可。

工作区可选、按需加载（Sparse & Virtualized）：客户端只拉自己关心的目录或文件，没读过的文件根本不用下载到硬盘上。

项目团队仅 7 个人，在 5 个月内不仅写了 Scion，还自研了配套的代码审查工具 Antique、代码搜索和权限系统。

详细 ↓ https://best.xiaohu.ai/article/anthropic-scion-source-control/

DigUp ：一款 Mac 开源菜单栏搜索工具

它基于基于 Google 多模态嵌入向量模型 EmbeddingGemma 2开发

你哪怕完全忘记了文件名，只要用自然语言描述你记得的画面、声音或内容，它不仅能帮你找到文件

还能直接带你跳到视频的具体秒数、音频的对应话题、PDF 的对应页码，甚至代码的具体行数...

大家的痛点：Mac 自带的 Spotlight 只能搜文件名、部分文档正文和元数据；

但如果你只记得“视频里出现过斑马”、“播客里聊过睡眠”、“合同里有一条关于宠物”或者“一段指数退避重试的代码”，原生搜索就无能为力了。

DigUp 的解决方式：基于 Google DeepMind 开源的多模态嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2，把文字、图片、音频、视频全都转化为计算机可以比对的数学向量（768 维空间），实现真正的本地跨模态语义搜索。

最大特色：精准内部定位

找到视频会直接调用播放器跳到画面出现的时刻
搜播客直接跳到那句话的音频区间
搜 PDF 自动翻到具体条款页码。
